title: When We Met
story: We match on Hinge! After a long talking phase (shoutout to Niels' wisdom teeth removal), we officially go on our first date on 12/12/2020! Marking the official anniversary of when Bess fell in love with Kona (and started dating Niels).

title: When We Adventured
story: Our first vacation as a couple to the beautiful island of Maui! This adventure kicks off our love for exploring the world together!

title: When We Moved In Together
story: We move in together! Bess was living in Mountain View, Niels in Fort Mason; we decide to meet in the middle in beautiful San Mateo. This begins the exploration of the town that we'd call home for a long time.

title: When We Traveled... A LOT
story: These two years bring nonstop adventuring with each other and our loved ones. Our love of travel goes international (Aruba, England), Bess introduces Niels to the wonderful world of Disney (and the commitment needed to maximize lightning lanes), and our families join in on the fun (Galapagos, Mexico, Hawaii, and Noelle's Wedding)!

title: When We Bought a House
story: After falling in love with San Mateo and feeling so grateful for our community in the Bay Area (especially our adorable nephews and niece), we buy a house!

title: When He Bought A Ring
story: A ring is purchased, blessings are given (thank you Ceci and Matt!), and Niels begins to plan for a big moment.

title: When She Said "Yes!"
story: The big moment comes! We get engaged at the spot of our first date in Fort Mason alongside good friends, a good dog, and lots of champagne!

title: When We Say "I Do"
story: We get married! And we can't wait to celebrate this next adventure with you all. Here are the details!
